$comment: Deployable Hive components, in deployment order (the control plane before the BFF that calls it). image: registry repository under IMAGE_PREFIX; app: default CapRover app name (override with CAPROVER_APP_<NAME>, token CAPROVER_TOKEN_<NAME>); paths: files whose change requires redeploying the component (both services embed the shared starter and ui-artifact-security); smoke: smoke.mjs options that receive the component's commit.
